subject: Piercer
picture: A large piercer hangs from the cave ceiling. It is a living stone spike with a clear snail-like head and two eyestalks near the top of the spike, big enough to read at a glance. A few ordinary stalactites hang nearby so the fake one stands out. Cave ceiling, rock walls, large floor stones, closed wooden door. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02.
